question: What shows that Jehoram was not honored at his death?
options: He was buried in the tombs of the kings
The people held a great feast
There was no funeral fire and he died to no one's regret
His sons mourned for forty days
explanation: The people made no funeral fire in his honor; he passed away to no one's regret and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
